author: claude

requirement.text:
Use site Hedingen2026
 -In flight planning, use custom terrain from an already processed mission where at least some parts of the terrain differs from the default terran. E.g. if you have trees or buildings included in the terrain. 
Check the altitude graph so it is different for this imported terrain compared to the default 'World' terrain
Now, download the flight plan offline while having the custom terrain selected.
Go offline
Open the flight plan and check so the custom terrain is selected in the left sidebar and that the altitude graph is using the custom terrain and not the default terrain.

source.locator: New test description, W-20261110-004 (your answer: flight Customterrain_02)

expected: In Hedingen2026, flight Customterrain_02 has map 20261020_10462_survey61_ground chosen as its custom terrain: the left sidebar's terrain selector shows 20261020_10462_survey61_ground online; after the site is downloaded for offline use (Enable offline use, 'Site available offline') and Wi-Fi is off, the same flight opens and the selector still shows 20261020_10462_survey61_ground. Nothing is saved.

parts.text: Open flight Customterrain_02 in Hedingen2026 online
Online: the flight uses custom terrain 20261020_10462_survey61_ground
parts.quote: use custom terrain from an already processed mission

parts.text: Download Hedingen2026 for offline use with the custom terrain selected
parts.quote: Now, download the flight plan offline while having the custom terrain selected.

parts.text: Offline: open the flight; the sidebar still shows the custom terrain
parts.quote: Open the flight plan and check so the custom terrain is selected in the left sidebar

steps_note: Blocks: TERR-001.c2.json steps 1-7 (site search, open flight, Edit, Layers); README start and clean-up blocks; offline-sites.md ... menu toggle and wifi off/on. steps.text: Open the site search (if it is not open yet) (download)
Search for Hedingen2026 (download)
Open the Hedingen2026 card's ... menu (only when the site is not offline yet)
Turn on Enable offline use in the menu (starts the download; only when it is off)
steps.when_js: (() => { const e = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')].find(e => { let p = e; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && p; i++) { if (/Enable offline use/.test(p.innerText || '')) return true; p = p.parentElement; } return false; }); return !!e && e.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true'; })()
steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Enable offline use" --expect "js:/Downloading offline site|Site available offline/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 30

steps.text: Wait for 'Site available offline' (up to 5 min)
